Lina: Hi folks — quick onboarding question. I selected the standard medical plan during sign-up but got an email that my coverage "pending". When does health insurance actually become active for new hires? Also I paid for a pre-start expense (flight for relocation) 120 on my card; how do I submit that for reimbursement?

Harpreet: Welcome Lina! :wave: Health coverage effective date depends on plan and carrierut for most employees coverage becomes active the first of the month following 30 days of employment. If you start 2025-11-10, coverage likely starts 2025-12-01. You should have an enrollment confirmation email from BenefitsTeam and the carrier once it's active.

BenefitsBot: Coverage note: plan "Standard PPO" enrollment received 2025-11-09 08:14 PT. Anticipated effective date: 2025-12-01. Please allow 7-10 business days for carrier card issuance.

PeopleOps: For the relocation flight: submit via Expensify -> New Expense -> Category: Relocation -> attach electronic ticket + itinerary + brief note (reason: new hire relocation). Select "Reimbursement - ACH". If you paid with company-approved travel vendor/card we usually auto-reconcile; since you used personal card tag it as "out-of-pocket". Expect reimbursement ~5-10 business days after approvals.

Lina: Thanks! Do I need manager approval first or can I submit directly? Also any docs needed for tax reporting?

Harpreet: Submit directly but select your manager for approval in the workflow (Expensify has the approver dropdown). For tax: relocation reimbursements under our policy are taxable unless pre-approved as non-taxable moving expense (rare). We will include reimbursement on your paystub; finance will send a confirmation. If you want non-taxable treatment, ping people-ops with the signed moving authorization form.

Lina: Got it. One more small thing  my dependent info in the portal is blank but I uploaded docs earlier. Where does that show?

PeopleOps: Dependent verification lives in Benefits Portal -> Documents -> Dependents. If you uploaded during onboarding it may take 2 business days to sync with carrier. If after 3 business days it's still blank, DM us and we'll escalate with HRIS.

Lina: Perfect, thanks everyone! :smile:
